name: gpx-route-map
description: Render a GPX track as an interactive OpenStreetMap map with waypoints and an elevation profile.
author: Manuel Camargo

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages/gpx-route-map.pot --domain=gpx-route-map --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,tools,dev,.git,.github,.spec,.wordpress-org,build/maplibre-gl-*.js,build/view.js
scripts.i18n:update: wp-env run cli wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages/gpx-route-map.pot wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/gpx-route-map/languages --no-purge --pretty-print
scripts.i18n: pnpm run build && pnpm run i18n:pot && pnpm run i18n:mo && pnpm run i18n:json
scripts.check:pcp: wp-env run cli wp plugin check gpx-route-map --exclude-directories=node_modules,vendor,tests,.git,.github,.spec,.wordpress-org,.phpunit.cache,.vscode,tools --ignore-codes=hidden_files,application_detected,compressed_files
